items.headline: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
items.hook: A new AI paper is getting attention: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
points: The authors designed and built the Xing 4 series of large language models, describing architecture selection, large‑scale pretraining, and a unified agent execution platform called TeleGym. They report that their infrastructure enables pretraining of a 285B‑parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards and supports advanced reasoning and agentic workloads.
The authors report: "Together, these mechanisms support the pretraining of a 285B-parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards, providing a concrete setting for the architectural and systems studies."
items.takeaway: These are the authors' own claims, and a preprint may not have been peer reviewed yet.
items.ask: Does this match what you see in practice?
